title: Tests: core (api, application, unit, integration)
purpose: The core test suite for the production FastAPI/RAG stack. It covers the API routes (chat, health, feedback), the application layer (RAGChatService hallucination guarding, RAGPipeline orchestration, session/memory management, query rewriting), domain entities (ConversationMemory), the infrastructure retrieval path (BM25, FAISS, HybridRetriever, cross-encoder reranker, confidence engine, context composition, prompt building, chunking, loaders), the analytics subsystem (event bus, metrics store, dashboards, alerts, reports), and parts of the robot stack (SystemRuntime failure recovery and full conversation flows) and evaluation tooling (RetrievalReportGenerator). Most RAG tests substitute fake loaders/chunkers/stores or mock LLM services so no running Ollama, embedding model, or network is needed; several integration tests do spin up real components (real SQLite, real FAISS/BM25/sentence-transformers) and a few reference live services.

files.purpose: Package marker for the test suite with a one-line docstring.
files.notes: Empty marker file; no test logic.

files.purpose: Shared pytest configuration that seeds the OLLAMA_MODEL environment variable for all tests.

files.purpose: Black-box tests of the POST /chat route using a fake LLM service and a mocked RAG pipeline injected into the FastAPI app.

terms.definition: Domain object pairing a retrieved KnowledgeDocument with a distance score; lower distance means higher similarity in this codebase.
Domain entity wrapping indexed content plus metadata (source, title, category, etc.).

Blank message returns 422 from FastAPI validation. FakeLLMService avoids a live Ollama.

files.purpose: Unit tests for RAGChatService low-confidence fallback (distance threshold) and streaming generation behavior, including session memory recording.

terms.definition: A similarity cut-off; search results whose FAISS/cross-encoder distance exceeds the threshold are treated as unreliable and trigger the low-confidence fallback reply instead of LLM generation.
The canned reply 'I couldn't find reliable information about that. Could you rephrase your question?' returned when retrieval is below the confidence/distance bar.
Per-session ConversationMemory storing user/assistant messages; tests verify respond_stream writes the query and reply into the session.

files.notes: Uses a dummy LLM recording generate/generate_stream call counts to prove the LLM is NOT invoked on high-distance results. Distance 2.5 vs threshold 1.0 in the fake pipeline. Session messages are dicts with 'content' keys.

terms.definition: Application-layer orchestrator that ingests documents (load -> chunk -> add to store -> save) and searches a similarity store.
Backward-compatible RAGPipeline entry point that ingests a source file (PDF name retained in the API even though loading is generic).

files.notes: FakeSimilarityStore records add/save/load calls. Confirms pipeline.search returns the chunker's output chunk, not the raw document.

files.purpose: Comprehensive unit tests for optimized ConversationMemory (history, summarization, token budgeting), SessionManager (TTL/clear), and QueryRewriter (multi-turn pronoun resolution and topic drift).

terms.definition: Domain entity holding per-session message history with max_history_turns, overflow summarization, and token-budget truncation.
How many user/assistant turns (2 messages each) are kept in working history before older ones are condensed into a summary.
Estimated token accounting split across system_prompt, conversation_history, retrieved_context, and user_query, used to decide truncation within max_context_tokens.
Thread-safe registry mapping session_id -> ConversationMemory with TTL expiration and explicit clear.
Time-to-live in seconds; sessions older than ttl_seconds are evicted by cleanup_expired_sessions().
Application service that expands follow-up queries, resolving pronouns ('its', 'timings') against recent history while avoiding stale-topic pollution.

files.notes: Tests assert summary contains 'Q:' style key facts on overflow and that 'library' is not injected when a new query changes topic to hostel. Uses real time.sleep(0.2) against a 0.1s TTL and get_settings() to verify SessionManager defaults match settings.

data_flow: The test suite consumes the src/campus_helpdesk package (and a few legacy/root-level modules) exactly as production does: FastAPI TestClient drives the API layer (create_app with injected/mocked LLM services), RAGChatService/RAGPipeline are exercised directly with fake loaders/chunkers/stores or real FAISS/BM25/sentence-transformers components, and the robot stack is driven through the real EventBus by publishing EventEnvelope objects manually. Shared settings come from get_settings() with the conftest OLLAMA_MODEL seed; env vars (OFFLINE_LLM_MODEL, ENABLE_CONTEXT_COMPOSER) and Settings constructor kwargs are used to test configuration paths. The analytics tests write real SQLite files under tmp_path and publish events over a real threaded EventBus. Outputs are assertion results consumed by pytest; the test_rag_consistency suite produces a printed 10-question accuracy report under __main__.
external_deps: sentence-transformers — real SentenceTransformerEmbeddings in integration tests
faiss — real FAISSSimilarityStore in integration tests
legacy root modules (ttt_service.TTTService, evaluation.benchmarks.*) — referenced by test_rag_consistency and test_retrieval_report_generator
local Ollama (via OLLAMA_MODEL env) — only implicitly, most tests avoid a live instance
risks: test_rag_consistency.py imports the legacy ttt_service.TTTService and hard-codes ground-truth strings (Block C/2nd floor, 8 AM-8 PM, fabricated-hours blacklist), so it breaks silently if the knowledge corpus or model changes; it is a benchmark, not a pytest test, and is skipped by test collection.

Multiple integration tests reach into private attributes (app.state.chat_service._rag_pipeline, runtime.inference._backend.simulate_delay_sec, runtime.camera._use_mock_fallback) and assert on dict-typed message shapes, coupling tests to implementation details.
test_full_conversation imports cv2 and numpy unconditionally, so it fails to import if OpenCV is not installed in the venv.

Several tests rely on real time.sleep for async EventBus handler delivery (0.1-2.0s), which is timing-flaky on slow CI; there is no deterministic flush/wait primitive for the analytics or interaction event buses.

test_single_production_pipeline and test_sprint2_pipeline require a real loaded FAISS index and real embedding/reranker models on disk (gated by FAISS_ALLOW_DANGEROUS_DESERIALIZATION / EMBEDDING_LOCAL_FILES_ONLY), so they degrade or fail when index artifacts are absent.

test_sprint1_core's MetadataManager.validate asserts warnings for 'invalid-type' document_type and 'Invalid Department' — category/document_type/department enum drift in the validator breaks these assertions.
test_retrieval_report_generator depends on the root-level evaluation.benchmarks package (not src/), which is not covered by the layered-src test config and may be missed if pytest pythonpath changes.

Hardcoded domain facts (library 8 AM-8 PM, admissions 10 AM-4 PM, phone 555-0199, library@campus.edu) are scattered across test_rag_consistency verifiers rather than centralized in a fixtures/ground-truth module.

Conftest sets only OLLAMA_MODEL; there is no centralized fixture factory for the common fake pipeline/LLM service pattern, which is re-implemented in each test file with slightly different fake classes.
